models.name: Opus
models.guidance: The default: Anthropic's recommended starting model for most work, strong at coding, review and long agentic tasks, with a 1M context; it costs about twice Sonnet per token, so cheaper models suit simple or high-volume chores.

models.name: Sonnet
models.guidance: Close to Opus on everyday coding at about half its price, with a 1M context; a good fit for routine implementation, tests and docs, and weaker than Opus on the hardest debugging and design.

models.name: Haiku
models.guidance: Anthropic's fastest and cheapest model, with a 1M context; good for quick lookups, summaries, triage and small edits, and not suited to complex multi-file changes or subtle reviews.

models.name: Fable
models.guidance: Anthropic's most capable model, for the hardest reasoning and long-horizon work; it is very expensive and draws heavily on plan budget, so only a person starts it, and routine work never needs it.

models.name: 6 Astra
models.guidance: OpenAI's most capable Codex model for complex code, apps and research; it costs about as much as Fable, so it is for hard problems where it is wanted by name, not for routine work.

models.name: 6.1 Sol
models.guidance: Near-Astra performance in Codex at about a fifth of Astra's price, close to Sonnet's cost; strong for complex coding and review in Codex.

models.name: 6.1 Terra
models.guidance: A fast, efficient Codex model for clear writing, visual understanding and computer use, about half Sol's price; less suited to the hardest engineering problems.

models.name: 6 Luna
models.guidance: OpenAI's most efficient Codex model for focused, high-volume tasks, priced like Haiku; not suited to complex multi-step engineering.

models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
models.guidance: A very low-cost DeepSeek model through OpenRouter, in Claude Code or Pi, with a 1M window; good for bulk, well-specified coding and background chores, with quality and tool use behind the Anthropic and OpenAI models.

models.name: GLM 5.3
models.guidance: Z.ai's flagship through OpenRouter in Claude Code, with a 1M context and always-on reasoning; a low-cost option for general coding that trails Opus on hard problems.

models.name: GLM 5.3 Flash
models.guidance: Z.ai's very cheap multimodal flash model through OpenRouter in Pi; suited to light, high-volume tasks, not to complex or high-stakes changes.

models.name: MiMo v2.6 Flash
models.guidance: Xiaomi's low-cost fast model through OpenRouter, in Claude Code or Pi; suited to quick, cheap, repeatable runs and not to complex engineering.
